headline: Pyxus International Reports Q2 Fiscal 2027 Results and Tightens EBITDA Guidance
summary: Pyxus International reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 net income of $4.1 million and adjusted EBITDA of $43 million, while tightening its full-year adjusted EBITDA guidance range.
why: Pyxus International is a global agricultural company involved in the supply chain for leaf tobacco and other products, sensitive to crop cycles and shipping cadences.
